added.summary: `position-visibility` takes `anchors-valid` (hidden while an anchor its placement reads is missing) and any combination of `anchors-valid`, `anchors-visible` and `no-overflow` (CSS Anchor Positioning 1 §4.1); `anchors-visible` stays the default. `no-overflow` together with a clipped anchor now hides on either condition. `anchors-visible` now also hides when a box between the anchor and the anchored element clips it out (`overflow: hidden` or `clip`, paint containment), not only a scroll container.
